_comment: Single source of truth for Florence postcard copy. Read by florence_postcard.py (production/Lob) AND mirrored by Postcard Mailer.html (design tool). Edit here; both surfaces stay in sync. Value + activation only — no FICA / visa / tax language. No italics, no em-dashes. {verb} and {city} are filled per-account.

quote.head: Permanent RNs, committed for two years. The capacity to care for more.
quote.sub: Globally-educated, U.S.-licensed RNs placed direct on your payroll. No travelers, no agency premium.

market.head: Your next nurse doesn't have to be a traveler.
market.sub: Florence places permanent, globally-educated RNs, fully U.S.-licensed, direct on your payroll, to {verb} in {city} without agency markup.
